parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of driver IDs. You can specify up to 30 driver IDs, which means you can query information about up to 30 drivers at a time. For the format, see the request example in this topic
parameters.help_zh: 驱动ID列表。最多可填写30个驱动ID，即一次最多支持查询30个驱动的信息。格式请参见本文下方请求示例
parameters.name: driver_ids

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates a successful call. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

CpuArch.description_en:
The CPU architecture supported by the driver. Valid values:

armv7
armv7-hf
aarch64
x86-64
x86
CpuArch.description_zh:
驱动适配的CPU架构。有如下几种架构：

armv7
armv7-hf
aarch64
x86-64
x86

DriverProtocol.description_en:
The communication protocol of the driver. Valid values:

modbus: Modbus communication protocol.
opc-ua: OPC UA communication protocol.
customize: custom communication protocol
DriverProtocol.description_zh:
驱动通信协议。

modbus：Modbus通信协议。
opc-ua：OPC UA通信协议。
customize：自定义通信协议

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was created

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新驱动的Unix时间戳

IsBuiltIn.description_en:
Indicates whether the driver file is built-in. Valid values:

true: The driver is a built-in driver, which means the driver code is pre-installed on the gateway.
false: The driver is not a built-in driver
IsBuiltIn.description_zh:
驱动文件是否内置。

true：表示驱动为内置驱动，即驱动代码已预置到网关上。
false：表示驱动为非内置驱动

Runtime.description_en:
The programming language of the driver. Valid values:

nodejs8: Node.js v8
python3: Python v3.5
c: C language
Runtime.description_zh:
驱动的语言类型。有如下三种类型：

nodejs8：Node.js v8
python3：Python v3.5
c: C语言

Type.description_en:
The driver type. Valid values:

0: official driver.
1: custom driver
Type.description_zh:
驱动类型。

0：表示官方驱动。
1：表示自研驱动

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
